headline: Photocatalytic oxidation, explained in 3 steps.
caption:
How does ductFIT treat air? With a process inspired by nature: photocatalytic oxidation (PCO).

1️⃣ Air carrying oxygen and water vapour moves through the unit
2️⃣ UV light activates a catalyst surface
3️⃣ The reaction produces low levels of reactive molecules that act on selected contaminants while the unit runs

Same technology across the range, from in-duct units to standalone room units. Save this post to explain it to your team 🔖

headline: What is PM2.5?
caption:
PM2.5 = particulate matter 2.5 micrometres or smaller. For scale, a human hair is roughly 50–70 micrometres wide.

Common sources indoors and out:
• Dust and sand events
• Traffic and construction
• Cooking and frying
• Bakhoor and candles

You can't see it, so the only way to know your levels is to measure. Save this for later 🔖

caption:

• Printers and adhesives
